# OpenLiate — Open Source Backend Layer for AI Agents

> OOP — Class is an Agent, Agent is an API.
> Selected for India's Sarvam AI Startup Program 2026.
> Founder: Vinod Hatti (Y Combinator Winter 2027 applicant).

## Overview
OpenLiate (Liate) is a sovereign, local-first open-source backend runtime and framework for autonomous AI agents.
It provides a 5-layer algebraic architecture:
- L: LLM (Multi-model hot-swappable layer across Sarvam AI, OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, and local Ollama)
- I: Integration (Unified protocols, MCP Model Context Protocol, REST, WebSockets)
- A: Agent (OOP runtime — Class is an Agent, Agent is an API)
- T: Tools (Sovereign sandbox execution, deterministic sandboxed tool calling)
- E: Environment (Local-first, sub-millisecond execution, zero cloud leakage)

## Quickstart
```bash
bunx @openliate/liate run agent.json
```
